text:
The Tiki Totem was introduced in Desktop 1.2, according to the History section of the Terraria Wiki's Tiki Totem page. I could not confirm this in the 1.2 changelog, which doesn't list it, so treat it as likely rather than certain. The team note is also wrong: the Tiki Totem is not a decorative, craftable item. It is a pet-summoning item sold by the Witch Doctor in the Jungle during Hardmode.

CONFIDENCE: 70
